CustomField.description: TNCI 139 / ELV-CPQ-036. Converted from a writable Date to a Roll-Up Summary. Nue port of CPQ SBQQ__Quote__c.Exit_ARR_End_Date__c, which is MAX of the quote line end-date EDW mirror filtered on Exclude_ARR_Formula__c = true (misleading name; TRUE means include). Nue equivalent: MAX of Ruby__SubscriptionEndDate__c filtered on ELV_Include_in_ARR_Calc__c = true. Display field only - no formula, roll-up or Apex consumes it in either org, so the conversion changes no ARR value.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The latest end date of the ARR-eligible quote lines on this quote.
CustomField.label: Exit ARR End Date
